components.purpose: Web application hosting
API hosting
Relational database with high availability
Caching for session and product data
Object storage for product images and assets
Secret management
Central logging and telemetry

design.rationale: This high-availability e-commerce architecture is deployed in New Zealand North to satisfy strict data residency requirements for PII. Compute is handled by zone-redundant App Service Premium v3 instances running the web application and API layers. PostgreSQL Flexible Server with zone-redundant high availability and private endpoints securely stores relational data, backed by Azure Cache for Redis and ZRS Blob Storage. Key Vault and Log Analytics ensure comprehensive security and operational monitoring well within the 9,000 NZD monthly budget.
tradeoffs: Azure Cache for Redis standard C1 is deployed without zone redundancy as it is not supported on this tier, but meets availability needs.
Application Gateway WAF v2 was omitted to keep costs lean within budget, relying on App Service security features.

design.rationale: The iwi land records archive architecture is deployed entirely within New Zealand North (Auckland) to strictly honour data residency requirements for sensitive personal and cultural heritage data. App Service S1 hosts the web application with private endpoints securing database and storage access. design.rationale: The insurance claims triage workload is designed with high availability and zone redundancy anchored in Australia East to support Azure OpenAI and all required components. App Service Premium v3 and PostgreSQL Flexible Server provide scalable, production-grade compute and database layers for handling sensitive personal and health information. Azure OpenAI o4-mini Data Zone Standard processes AI claims classification and summarisation while complying with the regional data boundary. Blob storage with ZRS secures attachments, Key Vault manages secrets, App Gateway WAF v2 protects inbound web traffic, and Log Analytics ensures full auditability.
tradeoffs: Australia East is selected as the primary region to ensure Azure OpenAI model availability and full service compatibility within the ANZ residency boundary.
